| The Order: 1886 | CUSA00035 | 0.16.0 | reach menu | Relaxed required | high | At least Relaxed is needed to reach the menus; Precise provided no noticeable benefit for this scope. | [source](https://github.com/shadps4-compatibility/shadps4-game-compatibility/issues/232#issuecomment-4704232581) |
| DRIVECLUB | CUSA00093 | 0.17.0 | reach ingame | Precise required | high | Stock and Relaxed crash before gameplay; Precise reaches gameplay. | [source](https://github.com/shadps4-compatibility/shadps4-game-compatibility/issues/1006#issuecomment-5234025452) |
| DRIVECLUB | CUSA00093 | — | daytime rendering | Precise required | high | Daytime races require Precise to look right; Relaxed flickers and Disabled is too dark. | [source](https://github.com/shadps4-compatibility/shadps4-game-compatibility/issues/1536#issuecomment-4173849737) |
| Surgeon Simulator | CUSA00861 | 0.17.0 | vertex integrity | Relaxed required | high | Relaxed fixes the reported vertex explosions. | [source](https://github.com/shadps4-compatibility/shadps4-game-compatibility/issues/2760) |
| Surgeon Simulator | CUSA00861 | 0.17.0 | shadow rendering | Precise beneficial | high | Precise improves shadow occlusion relative to Relaxed/default, but shadows still flash; this is not a claim of full correctness. | [source](https://github.com/shadps4-compatibility/shadps4-game-compatibility/issues/2760) |
| Trine 3: The Artifacts of Power | CUSA03082 | 0.18.0 | geometry rendering | Precise required | high | On 0.18.0 there is no geometry unless Precise readbacks are enabled. | [source](https://github.com/shadps4-compatibility/shadps4-game-compatibility/issues/1967#issuecomment-5805482042) |
| DARK SOULS III | CUSA03365 | — | vertex integrity | Relaxed required | high | Minor vertex explosions after extended play are fixed by enabling at least Relaxed readbacks. | [source](https://github.com/shadps4-compatibility/shadps4-game-compatibility/issues/1651#issuecomment-5958992935) |
| YAKUZA 3 | CUSA15325 | 0.18.0 | geometry rendering | Precise required | high | On 0.18.0 the world is a black abyss unless Precise readbacks are enabled. | [source](https://github.com/shadps4-compatibility/shadps4-game-compatibility/issues/1999#issuecomment-5804804279) |
| YAKUZA 4 | CUSA15326 | 0.18.0 | geometry rendering | Precise sufficient | medium | Precise restores world geometry on 0.18.0, but the cited report does not establish whether Relaxed is insufficient. | [source](https://github.com/shadps4-compatibility/shadps4-game-compatibility/issues/2000#issuecomment-5805084782) |
